stream_flow.notes: one per stream_straight tile (2 m), rotated with the tile; chains top-to-bottom

waterfall_sheet.notes: in front of waterfall's sheet (z -0.3); covers y 0.65-3.3 m, the splash covers the foot

waterfall_splash.notes: at the foot of the waterfall (z 0.0)

glowroot_pool.notes: neon-blue cold-fire pool under glowroot_arch / glowroot_cluster / neon_mushrooms_blue / blue orbs

toadstool_glow_pool.notes: red neon pool under toadstool_giant / toadstool_shelf / red orbs

pool_violet.notes: under neon_mushrooms_violet / glowfern / blight_bloom / violet orbs

glow_mist_blue.notes: surreal glow fog: scatter 3-6 over water / low ground, overlapping, random frame offsets

glow_mist_violet.notes: violet fog for blight rooms / the Regent arena

glow_mist_green.notes: green fog for the Heartseed / Hjortur arena

fireflies_neon.notes: mixed neon fireflies, 12 per cell; scatter many

glow_orb_blue.notes: hovering blue glow orb (orb centre ~2.2 m when lift 1.1); add glowroot_pool decal beneath

glow_orb_violet.notes: hovering violet glow orb (orb centre ~2.2 m when lift 1.1); add pool_violet decal beneath

glow_orb_red.notes: hovering red glow orb (orb centre ~2.2 m when lift 1.1); add toadstool_glow_pool decal beneath

glow_orb_green.notes: hovering green glow orb (orb centre ~2.2 m when lift 1.1); add pool_green decal beneath

glow_orb_pink.notes: hovering pink glow orb (orb centre ~2.2 m when lift 1.1); add pool_pink decal beneath

blight_aura.notes: under the Blight Regent (scale x3 to his footprint)

root_eruption.notes: Regent attack frame 2 (the slam): spawn 3-5 in a line toward the player

regent_cleansed.notes: Regent die frame 3 (sapling): the blight lifts

greenheart_aura.notes: under Hjortur (guardian); use blight_aura for hjortur_corrupted

glowfrog_blue_idle.notes: ambient blue glow frog: throat-sac pulse + blink; 24 px cell (frog ~9x6 px = 0.5 m wide at 18 px/m: oversized a touch so it reads)

glowfrog_blue_hop.notes: one hop (0.6 s): move the frog ~0.5 m across the 6 frames, then back to idle

glowfrog_green_idle.notes: ambient green glow frog: throat-sac pulse + blink; 24 px cell (frog ~9x6 px = 0.5 m wide at 18 px/m: oversized a touch so it reads)

glowfrog_green_hop.notes: one hop (0.6 s): move the frog ~0.5 m across the 6 frames, then back to idle

glowfrog_pink_idle.notes: ambient pink glow frog: throat-sac pulse + blink; 24 px cell (frog ~9x6 px = 0.5 m wide at 18 px/m: oversized a touch so it reads)

glowfrog_pink_hop.notes: one hop (0.6 s): move the frog ~0.5 m across the 6 frames, then back to idle

glowfrog_violet_idle.notes: ambient violet glow frog: throat-sac pulse + blink; 24 px cell (frog ~9x6 px = 0.5 m wide at 18 px/m: oversized a touch so it reads)

glowfrog_violet_hop.notes: one hop (0.6 s): move the frog ~0.5 m across the 6 frames, then back to idle

stonefrost_cast_ii.notes: Stonefrost II cast flare at the hands: floating rune sigil (triangle) + rising motes + sparkles (NEON blue/teal)

stonefrost_bolt_ii.notes: Stonefrost II boulder rimed in glowing ice crystals, sparkles around it; replaces seed_bomb for tier II

stonefrost_impact_ii.notes: Stonefrost II impact: white-blue flash, snow ring, ice shards, stone chips, sparkles (radius ~1.9 m at 18 px/m x2)

stonefrost_rune_ii.notes: Stonefrost II Frost Rune trap decal: draws in over frames 0-3, frame 5 = armed (engine holds frame 5 like rune_trap); larger, brighter and with an outer ring per tier

stonefrost_burst_ii.notes: Stonefrost II trap trigger: pillar of cold light + shards (replaces glyph_burst)

stonefrost_cast_iii.notes: Stonefrost III cast flare at the hands: floating rune sigil (hexagram) + rising motes + sparkles (NEON blue/teal)

stonefrost_bolt_iii.notes: Stonefrost III boulder rimed in glowing ice crystals, sparkles around it; replaces seed_bomb for tier III

stonefrost_impact_iii.notes: Stonefrost III impact: white-blue flash, snow ring, ice shards, stone chips, sparkles (radius ~2.4 m at 18 px/m x2)

stonefrost_rune_iii.notes: Stonefrost III Frost Rune trap decal: draws in over frames 0-3, frame 5 = armed (engine holds frame 5 like rune_trap); larger, brighter and with an outer ring per tier

stonefrost_burst_iii.notes: Stonefrost III trap trigger: pillar of cold light + shards (replaces glyph_burst)

fire_wave.notes: Fire Wave (crescent of flame, sweeps right; flip for left)

magma_pool.notes: Magma Pool (damaging ground pool, r ~ 2-3 m; also Vharzul's rising lava edge when tiled)

ember_swarm.notes: Ember Swarm: a cloud of orbiting embers

flame_ward.notes: Flame Ward: a ring of small flames around the caster (shield)

hound_summon.notes: Magma Hound summon / alpha's call: a lava ring with a column rising

fire_wave_l.notes: Fire Wave (l), derived by musp_art.school from fire_wave

fire_wave_d.notes: Fire Wave (d), derived by musp_art.school from fire_wave

fire_wave_u.notes: Fire Wave (u), derived by musp_art.school from fire_wave

ember_mote.notes: Ember Swarm: one mote (drawn by musp_art.school in the swarm's colours)
